claim: Meta's Q2 2026 net income fell 14% year over year.
summary: Meta's Q2 2026 (quarter ending June 30, 2026) financial results would be released after the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04, so the claimed 14% year-over-year change in net income cannot be verified from pre-cutoff knowledge alone without retrieval.
